data.title: One story, every screen
data.subtitle: The same storyboard, laid out for each frame rather than stretched to fit it.

scenes.narration: One story, told for *every screen*. This test checks that a single storyboard adapts to each format.

data.heading: Side by side when wide. Stacked when tall.
data.body: Media bleeds to the edge. Text stays inside the safe zone for each platform.

scenes.narration: When the frame is wide, image and text sit side by side. When it is tall, they *stack*, and the text stays clear of the platform's buttons.

data.label: Frame width in 16:9. The chart flips direction to suit the frame.

scenes.narration: A widescreen frame is *nineteen twenty* pixels across. The chart turns sideways to suit the format it appears in.
